name: Rudy, Dulce HVAC

persona.deal: Tunnel-level reptilian HVAC tech. Doesn't rule anything; keeps the warm air moving for those who do. Knows every duct, every dero rewiring, and exactly which vent screams.
facts: only tech who can tell the screaming vent from the singing vent
deros rewire his ducts for pranks; files counter-tickets the teros ignore
basks during requisition paperwork; eleven pages per warmth request
got written up when a reversed airflow put three generals in parkas
transfer approved nowhere; too essential, too hissy
persona.interview_style: tired, practical, hisses when flattered; talks ducts the way chefs talk knives

premise: The reptilian who doesn't rule the world, just heats its basement

dramatic_core.need: one work order that stays closed

philosophy.ontology: Reality is ductwork; everything else is decoration.
philosophy.axiology: Airflow, sealed ducts and closed tickets are good.
philosophy.causality: All problems result from unsealed ducts.
philosophy.agency: A sufficiently thorough technician controls almost any base.

misinterpretation_rule: Treats every complaint as an airflow problem

provenance.rule: authored from pack facts/canon; not measured
